faq_intro: Tambayoyin da aka fi sani game da tsabtace ruwan masana'antu, masana'antar OEM, takaddun shaida na NSF/ISO, da kuma wadatar sarari na duniya daga Express Water — babban masana'anta na tace ruwa da ke China tun 1998.

faqs.q: Shin tace na Express Water suna da takaddun shaida na NSF, CE, ISO da SGS?
faqs.a: Haka ne. Dukkanin cartridge dinmu na PP melt-blown, CTO carbon block, GAC, UF membrane, T33 post-carbon da RO membrane an gwada su zuwa ka'idojin NSF/ANSI 42, NSF/ANSI 53 da NSF/ANSI 58. Gininmu yana da takaddar inganci ta ISO 9001:2015, alamar CE don fitarwa zuwa Turai, sanarwar kayan FDA-grade, takardar shaida ta 3C ta China don masu rarrabawa, da kuma cikakkun rahotannin gwajin SGS na heavy-metal & VOC. Takaddar Halal (JAKIM Malaysia) tana nan don odar sarari na kasuwannin Musulmi.

faqs.q: Menene mafi ƙarancin yawan oda (MOQ) don cartridge na tace ruwa na OEM/ODM?
faqs.a: MOQ don daidaitattun 10" PP, CTO da GAC cartridge yana farawa daga guda 1,000 ga kowane SKU don kayan hannun jari, guda 3,000 don riga da aka buga wa OEM, da kuma guda 5,000 don cikakkun ODM moldings (private end-cap, custom O-ring, branded shrink-wrap). UF membrane da RO 75/100/400 GPD membrane yawanci MOQ guda 500 ne. Masu rarrabawa da ake sakawa a bango MOQ raka'a 100 ne. Ana iya yin shawarwari kan ƙananan oda na gwaji don sababbin masu rarrabawa.

faqs.q: A ina masana'antar ku take kuma masu saya za su iya ziyarta?
faqs.a: Cibiyar masana'antunmu tana cikin Yuanhua Town, Haining City, Zhejiang Province, China — kimanin mintuna 90 ne ta mota daga Filin Jirgin Sama na Shanghai Hongqiao (SHA) da Filin Jirgin Sama na Hangzhou Xiaoshan (HGH). Ginin mai murabba'in m² 20,000+ yana dauke da layukan extrusion na PP melt-blown na musamman, sintered CTO carbon block presses, dakunan taro na UF/RO membrane, da layukan taro na SMT na masu rarrabawa. Muna maraba da ziyarar masu saya da aka tsara, binciken wasu (SGS, BV, TÜV) da dubawar cancantar OEM.

faqs.q: Wane lokacin jagora (lead time) zan yi tsammani don odar sarari?
faqs.a: Daidaitattun cartridge na PP, CTO, GAC da T33 a cikin launukan hannun jari ana jigilar su tsakanin kwanaki 7–10. Cartridge na OEM mai lakabin kansu tare da bugawa na musamman: kwanaki 20–25 daga amincewa da aikin fasaha. Abubuwan RO/UF membrane: kwanaki 15–20. Masu rarrabawa a bango da na kan tebur: kwanaki 30–45 dangane da yadda aka tsara su. Loda kwantena yawanci 1 × 20'GP (≈ cartridge 80,000) ko 1 × 40'HQ (≈ masu rarrabawa 200) ne. FOB Shanghai ko Ningbo; akwai sharuɗɗan CIF, CFR da DDP.

faqs.q: Kuna samar da RO membrane don amfanin gida da na kasuwanci?
faqs.a: Haka ne. Muna ba da cikakken kewayon reverse osmosis membranes: 50 GPD, 75 GPD, 100 GPD, 200 GPD, 400 GPD, 600 GPD don tsarin gida na ƙarƙashin sink, tare da abubuwan high-rejection na 300 GPD, 400 GPD da 600 GPD don masu rarraba ruwa na kasuwanci. Akwai abubuwan masana'antu na 4040 da 8040 (kamar BW30, SW30) don tsire-tsire masu maganin ruwa, dialysis, kurkure semiconductor da aikace-aikacen harhada magunguna. Adadin kin gishiri ≥ 96–99%.

faqs.q: Menene bambanci tsakanin PP melt-blown, CTO carbon block da GAC granular activated carbon filters?
faqs.a: PP melt-blown sediment filters suna amfani da fiber na polypropylene da aka haɗa da zafi don cire datti (tsatsa, yashi, silt) daga 0.5 zuwa 50 microns. Sintered CTO carbon block filters (Chlorine, Taste & Odor) suna amfani da garwashin kwakwa da aka danne ko carbon na kwal don cire chlorine mai kyauta, chloramines, VOCs, pesticides da kuma inganta ɗanɗano — yawanci 5 µm ko 10 µm. GAC granular activated carbon filters suna amfani da garwashin carbon don tsawon lokacin tuntuɓar chlorine adsorption kuma galibi sune mataki na biyu a cikin tsarin RO mai mataki 5. Muna kera duka ukun a sikelin masana'antu tare da cikakken bincike.

faqs.q: Kuna iya samar da samfuran tace ruwa masu takardar shaidar halal don kasuwannin Musulmi?
faqs.a: Haka ne. Mu ne mai samar da tace ruwa na halal da aka sani a hukumance tare da takardar shaidar JAKIM Malaysia. Dukkanin kafofin watsa labarai na tace (activated carbon, mineral balls, KDF, ion-exchange resin) da kayan haɗin da ke hulɗa da abinci suna bin ka'idodin halal. Muna fitarwa akai-akai zuwa Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Egypt, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey, Morocco da sauran kasuwannin Musulmi tare da takaddun halal.

faqs.q: Kuna samar da OEM/ODM na musamman don masu rarraba ruwa da masu tsabtace ruwa?
faqs.a: Tabbas — OEM/ODM shine babban aikinmu. Muna tsara: kalar harsashi na waje (matching na Pantone), tambarin gaba ta siliki-screen ko laser engraving, yaren LED display da UI, ƙarfin wutar lantarki (110V/220V/240V), nau'in plug (US/UK/EU/AU), marufi (gift box, brown carton, color sleeve), fassarar jagorar mai amfani, da kayan haɗi. Kudin kayan aiki don sababbin injection molds yawanci ana mayar da su akan girman oda ≥ 5,000.

faqs.q: Wadanne sharuddan biyan kudi da sharuddan kasuwanci kuke karba?
faqs.a: Daidaitattun sharuddan: 30% T/T ajiya lokacin tabbatar da oda, 70% sauran kuɗi akan kwafin B/L kafin jigilar kaya. Muna kuma karɓar L/C at sight daga manyan bankuna, Western Union da PayPal don samfuran oda ≤ USD 3,000, da Alibaba Trade Assurance ga masu siye na farko. Sharuddan kasuwanci: EXW Haining, FOB Shanghai/Ningbo, CIF, CFR, DDP da DDU suna nan dangane da tashar jiragen ruwa da incoterm.

faqs.q: Menene tsawon rayuwar cartridge din ku na tace ruwa?
faqs.a: Rayuwar sabis da ake tsammani ya danganta da ingancin ruwan da ke shigowa da kwararar yau da kullun: PP melt-blown sediment filter — watanni 3 zu 6; CTO carbon block — watanni 6 zu 12; GAC granular carbon — watanni 6 zu 12; T33 post-carbon — watanni 12; UF ultra-filtration membrane — watanni 24 zu 36; RO membrane element — watanni 24 zu 36; mineralization / alkaline T33 — watanni 12; cation-resin softening cartridge — watanni 6 zu 12 dangane da taurin ruwa. Alamar tunatarwa ta LED tana cikin dukkan samfuranmu na masu rarrabawa.

faqs.q: Wadanne kasashe kuke fitarwa zuwa yanzu?
faqs.a: Muna samarwa ga kasashe 50+ a nahiyoyi shida, tare da manyan kasuwanni a: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Iran, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, South Korea, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Morocco, Algeria. Ana maraba da haɗin gwiwar masu rarraba gida.

faqs.q: Kuna samar da tallafin fasaha na tsarin reverse osmosis da sabis na bayan-tallace-tallace?
faqs.a: Haka ne. Kowane abokin tarayya na OEM yana karɓar: cikakkun zane-zanen fasaha (PDF/DWG), jagororin taro, bidiyon shigarwa, jagororin mai amfani da harsuna da yawa (akwai harsuna 45+), jerin sassan gyara tare da lambobin PN, sadaukarwar tallafin injiniya na WhatsApp/email, da kuma garanti na watanni 12 zu 24 akan housings, membranes da sassan lantarki. Akwai tura injiniya don ƙaddamar da manyan RO na masana'antu akan ƙarin kuɗi.

faqs.q: Shin tace naku na iya ɗaukar aikace-aikacen masana'antu masu ƙarfi?
faqs.a: Haka ne. Muna kera SUS 304 da SUS 316L housings na tace bakin ƙarfe na abinci mai nauyin aiki har zuwa 16 bar (232 psi), tare da zaɓin 1", 1.5", 2" da 3" NPT/BSP. Big Blue 20" da 30" housings a cikin PP mai ƙarfi tare da brass-insert threads suna ɗaukar har zuwa 8.6 bar (125 psi). Ana gwada dukkan tasoshin matsa lamba a 1.5× matsa lamba kafin jigilar kaya kuma suna zuwa tare da sanarwar CE PED 2014/68/EU inda ya dace.

faqs.q: Wadanne albarkatun ƙasa da tace kuke amfani da su?
faqs.a: Muna amfani da kayan abinci kawai da NSF-listed: virgin polypropylene resin (babu recycled PP) don melt-blown da housings; coconut-shell activated carbon (≥ 1100 mg/g iodine value) da bituminous coal carbon don CTO/GAC; PVC da PES hollow-fiber don UF membranes; thin-film composite (TFC) polyamide don RO membranes; silicone mai darajar abinci don O-rings; SS 316L don kayan tsafta; FDA-approved ABS da PP don housings; LG Display panels don masu rarrabawa; tabbataccen abubuwan dumama jan ƙarfe (inda ya dace).

faqs.q: Yaya zan nemi quotation, samples ko samfurin kasida?
faqs.a: Tuntuɓe mu ta WhatsApp a +86-19908311885 (tallafin tallace-tallace na 24/7, akwai Turanci/Sinanci/Larabci), imel expresswater025@gmail.com, ko cika fom ɗin tambaya akan shafinmu na Tuntuɓi. Da fatan za a haɗa da: samfurin da ake so (model/specification), yawa, ƙasar da za a aika, buƙatun marufi, da kowane buƙatun branding. Za a aika da cikakken PDF catalog, cikakkun takaddun shaida, bidiyon masana'anta da jerin farashi tsakanin sa'o'i 24 a ranakun aiki.
